items.title: Dallas Officer Who Worked Off-Duty For Yella Beezy Placed On Leave
items.excerpt: A Dallas police officer who worked for Yella Beezy while off duty has been placed on administrative leave, WFAA reports.

items.title: Macklemore Pledges “Where Is Our Love” Proceeds To Gaza Mothers And Children
items.excerpt: Macklemore pledges proceeds from "Where Is Our Love" to the Mother of Hind Fund after his Palestinian benefit concerts.

items.title: Rockstar Sends GTA VI Festival Ticket Proceeds To Miami Charities
items.excerpt: Rockstar will donate all GTA VI festival ticket proceeds to Miami charities and has released set times for Cardi B and more.

items.title: Kodak Black Plays Himself And Hosts Haitian Radio In GTA VI
items.excerpt: Rockstar credits Kodak Black as himself in GTA VI and puts him behind the mic on a Haitian station presented by Michaël Brun.

items.title: 50 Cent Wins Dismissal Of Ex-Executive’s Lawsuit In Georgia
items.excerpt: A Georgia judge dismissed Monique Mayers' lawsuit against 50 Cent, and her attorney says she plans to pursue it elsewhere.

items.title: Becky G Closes Out Record Contract She Signed At 14
items.excerpt: Becky G looks ahead to life outside the contract she signed as a teenager, with a clearer sense of her musical identity.

items.title: Peter Gunz Invites Fans To Ask Him & Amina Buddafly Anything One Last Time
items.excerpt: Peter Gunz says he'll take questions with ex-wife Amina Buddafly on Dec. 15 after the Love & Hip Hop farewell finale.

items.title: Devin Brown Gets 10 Years In MO3 Killing After Guilty Plea
items.excerpt: Devin Brown pleaded guilty to helping orchestrate MO3's killing and got 10 years, after two other men received life sentences.

items.title: Doja Cat Bitter Out Rockstar Over GTA VI Snub: “Eat My Dick”
items.excerpt: Doja Cat called out Rockstar Games on launch day and told fans she wanted her music in the new Grand Theft Auto VI.
